boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places for studying, meeting, creating, recreation, and campus events, each supported by a Merrimack College source.

cards.title: McQuade Library
cards.subtitle: Four floors of solo and group study settings
cards.notes: Choose a floor to match your task: lively first-floor tables for groups, quieter upper areas for reading, or the lower-level stacks for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with distinctly paced study areas across four levels.
cards.evidence_claim: McQuade Library lists lively, quieter, silent, group, and individual study locations throughout its four levels.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours may vary; check the library calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Foyse Family Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a reading-heavy task or quiet individual work here; the library directory identifies this named room among its silent study options.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet room inside McQuade for lower-distraction study.
cards.evidence_claim: The McQuade Library directory lists the Foyse Family Quiet Study Room on the second floor and classifies it among silent study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library; confirm library access policies before arrival.

cards.title: McQuade 348 Collaborative Space
cards.subtitle: Writing, Tutoring & Math Center suite
cards.notes: Use the low tables and seating for a small project group, then connect with STEM tutoring or use the available computing and reference resources.
cards.short_summary: A small-group workspace paired with tutoring and computing resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack describes Room 348 as a collaborative space for groups of four to six, STEM tutoring, computers, and study resources.
cards.access_notes: McQuade Library, Room 348; tutoring availability follows the College's schedule.

cards.title: McQuade 346 One-on-One Workspace
cards.subtitle: Writing, Tutoring & Math Center suite
cards.notes: Schedule a writing consultation when needed, or use this quieter room for individual work without relying on a group-table environment.
cards.short_summary: A named room for individual workspace and writing consultations.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack identifies Room 346 as a quieter space with one-on-one tutoring spaces and individual workspace.
cards.access_notes: McQuade Library, Room 346; consultations may require scheduling.

cards.title: The Fishbowl
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, Room 352
cards.notes: Reserve this conference room to rehearse a group presentation, practice an interview, or use the full-size display for a working session.
cards.short_summary: A reservable presentation-practice room with a large monitor.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack says Room 352, “The Fishbowl,” supports presentation practice and interviews and has a full-size TV with Apple AirPlay.
cards.access_notes: One-hour reservations are made through TutorAIRS, according to Merrimack's academic-success page.

cards.title: Gladys Sakowich Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus lounges, offices, recreation, and events
cards.notes: Use the indoor Main Street as a practical meeting point, then branch to lounges, student services, campus recreation, or scheduled club programming.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 academic-year hub that joins student services, dining, recreation, and organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack calls the Sakowich Campus Center the heart of campus life, with lounges, dining, recreation, student services, and student organizations.
cards.access_notes: The College states the center is open 24 hours daily during the academic year; schedules can change.

cards.title: Sakowich Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Sakowich Campus Center
cards.notes: Plan a workout around its published daily schedule, and check the recreation page again during breaks or weather disruptions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus fitness center in the Sakowich Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack lists the Sakowich Fitness Center on the second floor of the Sakowich Campus Center and publishes its daily operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Mon–Thu 6:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m.; Fri 6:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; weekends vary. Hours may change.

cards.title: The Warrior's Den
cards.subtitle: Sakowich Campus Center dining area
cards.notes: Meet over a meal or a coffee in this campus-center dining area; review the dining page for current menus, meal-swipe options, and hours.
cards.short_summary: A Sakowich dining stop with multiple food stations and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack identifies The Warrior's Den in the Sakowich Campus Center as a student hangout with natural!, subconnection, coffee, snacks, and meal-swipe options.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require payment or an eligible meal swipe; check current dining hours before visiting.

cards.title: Rogers Center for the Arts
cards.subtitle: Campus venue for student-recognition events
cards.notes: Watch the campus events calendar for performances, talks, and student-recognition programs scheduled in this named arts venue.
cards.short_summary: A campus arts venue that also hosts student-organization recognition.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack reported that its annual L.E.A.D. Awards for student leaders, organizations, and student-athletes took place in the Rogers Center for the Arts.
cards.source_title: L.E.A.D. Awards Celebrate the Best of Student Organizations, Engagement
cards.access_notes: Access depends on the scheduled event; consult the College calendar or event organizer.

cards.entity_name: Collegiate Church of Christ the Teacher
cards.title: Collegiate Church of Christ the Teacher
cards.subtitle: Campus gathering place for service and scholarship events
cards.notes: Look for scheduled community events here, from service projects to academic gatherings, and follow the event’s participation or registration instructions.
cards.short_summary: A campus church used for worship and large community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack reported that 110 students, faculty, and staff used the Collegiate Church of Christ the Teacher for its 2026 MLK Day of Service bed-building project.
cards.source_title: Merrimack College Community Gathers to Build Children's Beds for MLK Day of Service
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; this is an active worship and campus-event space.
